effects.label: Burn
effects.description: Damages the recipient by a percentage of their MAX HP, once per tick, for the duration of the debuff. Creates a Damage Zone around the recipient, damaging any of their allies in the indicated radius by a percentage of their MAX HP every tick.The number of ticks per second increases with Skill Speed. This debuff can be stacked.

levels.text:
Selects 1 enemy up to 14m away. Attacks 10 enemies in a 5m radius around the target, from a distance of 9m, 3 times, dealing 37 damage per hit. The first hit launches the targets for 2s. Then, casts 2 [1.25% Burn] debuffs on the targets, lasting 6s, on the second hit. The [Burn] ticks every 2s, damaging targets by 1.25% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK). Also damages all of the target's allies in a 6m radius by 0.63% of their MAX HP per tick (up to 200% ATK).
Accuracy required for: Launch, Burn

effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.

levels.text:
Attacks 1 enemy from a distance of 9m, dealing 278 damage. Casts a [Stun] debuff on the target, lasting 8s. Stunned targets cannot move or use Skills, take 100% damage as normal, and their Skill Cooldowns will behave as normal. Then, casts a [14% Weaken] debuff on the target, lasting 15s, increasing all damage taken by 14% if the target is a Boss or if the target is a Miniboss. 
Attacks 1 enemy from a distance of 9m, dealing 278 damage. Pushes the target 10m away damage increases by 50% per debuff on the target, limited up to +150% damage.

bio: Duchess Kanraku is the scion of a terrifying Dynasty: portal masters, who can tear open the Void itself and travel to realms unknown. Kanraku has taken this power to new heights, and has begun to trap monstrous horrors in her void-prison… which she then unleashes on her hapless foes.
